verdict.rationale: Airweave provides an MCP server and official 'skills' so assistants like Claude, Cursor, and other MCP/skills-compatible clients can query the same synced collection, giving a shared-memory experience across tools (airweave-docs-5, airweave-docs-7, airweave-docs-21, airweave-probe-3). However, ChatGPT is never mentioned as a supported client, and there's no evidence of a unified persistent 'memory' abstraction beyond search-on-demand retrieval from synced sources. missing for 10: explicit ChatGPT/OpenAI integration support, evidence of true cross-tool persistent memory (vs per-query search), independent hands-on confirmation that multiple assistants share consistent state in practice.
